reasoning: One prescribed plane, with grass clumps, sparse bare earth and dry strands represented in material channels.

specDepthDecision.rationale: One quad with one mixed grass/soil PBR texture. Need macro patch distribution, meso clumping and fine blade direction.

detailInventory.scanMethod: full swatch, PBR map strip, standing-height and rotated-grid review

details.description: Olive, yellow-green and darker green grass cover most of the swatch.
Dense short narrow blades overlap at varied angles rather than forming long uniform stripes.
Small reddish-brown earth gaps interrupt the grass irregularly.
Thin pale straw-like dead strands are mixed through the green growth.
A few denser low clumps contrast with sparse worn patches.
Subtle broad worn patches show yellowed, less dense grass without a rigid boundary.
Dark small interstices occur between overlapping blades and at soil gaps.
Sparse small broader green leaves interrupt the narrow grass texture.
Fine mineral grit is visible in the bare earth openings.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: Preserve explicit 8 m single quad at y=0, with no blade meshes, cards or alpha testing.
Match mixed olive greens, narrow blades, dry strands, clumps and sparse red-earth openings.
Separate normal, roughness and subtle independent height-derived AO produce a restrained grass/soil response.
Review at standing-camera height and above; the stated poor ground-level silhouette is intentional. Check four-way rotated neighbors.
All runtime, resource and export checks pass and whole-asset estimate exceeds 95.
